description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 6 July 2018, led by Zeraora-GX, the mythical Pokémon of the 2018 film The Power of Us. Zeraora-GX's Ability lets every Pokémon with Lightning Energy attached retreat for free, and its GX attack attaches five basic Energy from the discard pile to its player's Pokémon. Virizion-GX, Magcargo-GX and Genesect-GX join it, with Prism Star Ditto and Thunder Mountain, the first Prism Star Stadium. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Kahili and Judge, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Electropower, Custom Catcher and Counter Gain. In English many of its cards came out in Lost Thunder in November 2018.
